title: Vaitheeswaran
desc: After the death of Saravanan, a sage tells his mother that her son will reincarnate if she never leaves the temple and prays. Thirty years later, an agnostic Dr Bala meets the mother to treat her.

title: Magalirkkaga
desc: Bhavani, an honest cop, seeks justice after a senior officer assaults her colleague, but her mission faces obstacles from her fiancé.

title: Oomai Vizhigal
desc: PRK, who is on a killing spree, is aided by a local politician and a nefarious doctor. However, a policeman and a committed journalist join hands to apprehend him.

title: Ponmanam
desc: An unemployed Anandhan's family has no expectations from him. However, when his parents commit suicide after his sister elopes, he is determined to find her.

title: Ratsasan
desc: Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a filmmaker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.
